intro.title: Meet Awwab — the pharmacist on deck.
intro.body: A calm place to discover what Pharmacy does, ask better medication questions, and see the quiet work that keeps patient care moving.
intro.welcomeQuestion: What would you like to know about your medicine?

safety.label: General pharmacy education
safety.body: Awwab shares general education and helps you find the right Pharmacy service. He does not replace a pharmacist, doctor, emergency service, or individual clinical assessment.
safety.urgent: If someone is severely unwell, has trouble breathing, collapses, or may have taken a harmful amount of medicine, seek urgent medical help immediately.

en.introTitle: Meet Awwab — the pharmacist on deck.
en.introBody: A calm place to discover what Pharmacy does, ask better medication questions, and see the quiet work that keeps patient care moving.
en.insideTitle: A clearer way to see Pharmacy.
en.purposeTitle: Pharmacy is more than a counter.
en.purposeBody: It is a chain of careful decisions, patient conversations, quiet checks, and people who keep showing up for the safety of others.
en.tourTitle: Follow the medicine beyond the counter.
en.tourBody: Choose a stop to see the people, systems, and patient value behind each part of Pharmacy.
en.servicesTitle: Ask the right question. Find the right door.
en.servicesBody: Explore the services that support patients, families, and the care team—from the front counter to the work that keeps the system moving.
en.questionsBody: Choose the closest starting point. Awwab will help you find a safe next step—not give a personal diagnosis.

ms.introTitle: Kenali Awwab — ahli farmasi yang sentiasa bersedia membantu.
ms.introBody: Ruang yang tenang untuk memahami peranan Farmasi, bertanya soalan tentang ubat dan melihat usaha senyap yang menyokong penjagaan pesakit.
ms.purposeBody: Ia terdiri daripada keputusan yang teliti, perbualan dengan pesakit, pemeriksaan senyap dan insan yang terus hadir demi keselamatan orang lain.
ms.tourBody: Pilih satu hentian untuk melihat insan, sistem dan manfaat kepada pesakit di sebalik setiap bahagian Farmasi.
ms.servicesTitle: Tanya soalan yang tepat. Cari pintu yang sesuai.
ms.servicesBody: Terokai perkhidmatan yang menyokong pesakit, keluarga dan pasukan penjagaan—daripada kaunter hadapan hingga kerja yang memastikan sistem terus bergerak.
ms.questionsTitle: Apa yang bermain di fikiran anda?
ms.questionsBody: Pilih titik permulaan yang paling hampir. Awwab akan membantu mencari langkah seterusnya yang selamat—bukan membuat diagnosis peribadi.
